qualification.education_qualification: Post-graduate in Clinical Embryology with 3 years ART lab experience OR Ph.D. in Clinical Embryology/ART/Fertility with 1 year ART lab experience OR MBBS/BVSc with post-graduate degree in Clinical Embryology and 2 years ART lab experience OR Post-graduate in Life Sciences/Biotechnology with 1 year Clinical Embryology training and 4 years ART lab experience.
qualification.details: Post-graduate in Clinical Embryology from a recognized University, through a full-time programme of minimum four semesters, with an additional three years of human ART laboratory experience in handling human gametes and embryos. Ph.D. holder, where the full-time Ph.D. project is related to Clinical Embryology or Assisted Reproductive Technology or Fertility, from a recognized University, with an additional one year of human ART laboratory experience in handling human gametes and embryos. Medical Graduate (MBBS) or Veterinary Graduate (BVSc) with a post-graduate degree in Clinical Embryology through a full-time programme from a recognized University, with an additional two years of ART laboratory experience in handling human gametes and embryos. Post-graduate in Life Sciences or Biotechnology with a minimum of one year of on-site, full-time Clinical Embryology certified training, in addition to four years' experience in handling human gametes and embryos in a registered ART Level-2 Clinic.

salary_details.details: Consolidated remuneration of ₹1,05,356/- per month. Tenure: One year.

ESIC Delhi Scientist Grade-I (Embryologist) Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Delhi Scientist Grade-I (Embryologist) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for ESIC Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for ESIC Delhi Recruitment 2026 is Scientist Grade-I (Embryologist).

faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 15 September 2026.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Scientist Grade-I (Embryologist) post is 69 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the consolidated remuneration for the Scientist Grade-I (Embryologist) post?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration for the Scientist Grade-I (Embryologist) post is ₹1,05,356/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications for the Scientist Grade-I (Embryologist) post?
faq.answer: Qualifications include Post-graduate in Clinical Embryology with 3 years ART lab experience, Ph.D. in Clinical Embryology/ART/Fertility with 1 year ART lab experience, MBBS/BVSc with post-graduate degree in Clinical Embryology and 2 years ART lab experience, or Post-graduate in Life Sciences/Biotechnology with 1 year Clinical Embryology training and 4 years ART lab experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee for all categories is Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original and self-attested copies of certificates/documents, recent passport-size photographs, valid photo identity proof, and any other required document.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Walk-in Interview venue?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview venue is ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Basaidarapur, New Delhi - 110015.
